cheats.name: Skip DRM authentication checkpoint
cheats.description: 하이브리드's DRM checkpoint only clears when a carrier auth backend delivers status 0x5001; with the LGT servers gone the session dispatcher at 0x1a28 always takes its failure chain and the title dead-ends on 인증에 실패하였습니다. This forces the dispatcher's status compare to always match, so it enters the auth-success handler regardless of any network response, and forces that handler's state-constructor index to the one valid subtype (3) instead of the response-buffer pointer it would otherwise index the jump table with (out of range → fault). The title then builds a session and reaches gameplay with no auth backend.
cheats.author: aram

patches.note: session dispatcher 0x1a28: `cmp r1,r1` instead of `cmp r1,r3`, so the following `bne` never taken and status is treated as the 0x5001 success value without a live carrier auth response
success handler 0x1934: `movs r4,#3` instead of `adds r4,r1,#0`, so the state subtype is the valid jump-table index 3 rather than the response-buffer pointer
